newsitem.title: USA: American Business ends $72.75 mln offering.
newsitem.headline: American Business ends $72.75 mln offering.

text.p: American Business Financial Services Inc said Monday that its main subsidiaries, American Business Credit Inc and Upland Mortgage completed a $72.75 million securitization backed by business and consumer purpose home equity loans on March 27.

The transaction was structured as a Real Estate Mortgage Investment Conduit (REMIC) entitled ABFS Mortgage Loan Trust 1997-1. The three Class A certificates each received a triple-A rating from Standard & Poor's Corp and Moody's Investor Service Inc, respectively.
Financial Security Assurance Inc insured all three Class A certificates.
The Class A-1 certificates total $32.1 million and were priced yield 6.371 percent with an issue price of 99-31+.
The Class A-2 certificates total $20.6 million and were priced to yield 6.936 percent with an issue price of 99-31.
The Class A-3 certificates total $20.05 million and were priced yield 7.595 percent with an issue price of 99-30+.
American Business Financial Services is a financial services holding company which provides an array of investment products and credit services to consumers and businesses.
